what: the reading of of3t-trunkfwd's three arms

instrument_floor_masked.what: upstream's own blocks re-composed in float64 from the captured input, masked. Everything the instrument itself contributes.

ratios_over_upstream_bf16.why: measured per block AND composed. Dividing one out of the other would assume the accumulation is linear, which is what the exponents below measure.

accumulation.why: p is the least-squares slope of log(composed rel) against log(depth) over the 48 blocks. p = 0.5 is independent rounding, p = 1.0 is a coherent per-block bias. The growth ratios are stated too because the exponent is a fit and the ratio is the raw observation.

reproduction_of_D87.why: an independent instrument, a different script, the same boundary. If these did not agree the D87 forward figure would be in question before anything else.

composition_is_the_models_not_the_instru.why: arm 3's per-block loop composed to the end is scored against the single `Pairformer.__call__`. Zero means the loop IS the shipped composition, so a per-block figure and the composed figure are of one function.

D86_transpose_fingerprint.why: if our pair output were their pair output transposed, rel against the reference would read near sqrt(2) with cos near 0 and rel against the TRANSPOSED reference would read near 0. ref_is_symmetric says how much of that test the reference itself could pass, since a symmetric z makes the check vacuous.
